svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: A band on stage with Merik2, seen from above
svg.desc: Illustration of a five-piece band on stage seen from above. The laptop with Merik2 stands at the back next to the stage box; the singer, guitarist, bassist and keyboard player read lyrics and chords on tablets and a phone; the keyboard player's tablet controls playback.
svg.text: Lyrics and chords on a tablet
Keys: has the key, runs playback
